# vpsie_file_shares (Data Source)

Lists the account's file shares.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsie_file_shares" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dc_identifier` (String) Only shares in this datacenter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `shares` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shares))

<a id="nestedatt--shares"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shares`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the share was created (RFC 3339).
- `dc_identifier` (String) The datacenter identifier.
- `gateway_vpc_ip` (String) The address inside the VPC that serves the share.
- `identifier` (String) The share identifier.
- `name` (String) The share name.
- `size_gb` (Number) The share size in GB.
- `state` (String) The share state.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Bytes used, as last measured.
